protocol: Grouped evaluation; final test is excluded from fitting and epoch selection. Legacy checkpoints saw portions of regrouped weather/OCT/parking data and cannot provide independent comparison scores.

weather.decision: Prefer independently evaluated grouped training to contaminated legacy split.

oct.decision: Use patient-separated training and evaluation; no clinical validation.

parking.decision: Prefer grouped cross-validation and sequence separation; unseen cameras remain untested.

alpaca.decision: Fresh pretrained initialization; best development checkpoint. Frozen test mAP50 improved from 0.7655 to 0.8613 and mAP50-95 from 0.4479 to 0.6843. Negative-image false detections remain (3/6 at 0.35).

tiger.decision: Publish as a separate limited prototype. Later-frame pose mAP50 is 0.9623, but stricter mAP50-95 is 0.2371. Approximate landmarks and same-video evaluation do not establish general animal pose estimation.
